name: Deliberate distortion
summary: The potter bends a thrown form when the clay is soft, so that the piece leans, the rim is oval and the base is not level.
how: Throw the form with a thick wall.
Press or cut the wall when the clay is soft.
Keep one side higher than the other by 5 to 15 mm.
Add a glaze that gathers in the dents.

origin.note: Tea master Furuta Oribe orders bent, square and lopsided tea ware from the Mino kilns.

adoptions.via: Mino potters press the rims and walls out of true to make each piece look alive.
